name: Ingersoll Rand
tagline: Global leader in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Industrial Technologies and Services represente le coeur de metier d'Ingersoll Rand, soit 6 056,4 M$ et 79 % du chiffre d'affaires 2025. Sa base installee genere des revenus aftermarket recurrents (40,6 % du CA segment), ce qui en fait l'indicateur operationnel le plus representatif de l'entreprise.

kpis.signal: Indicateur avance de la demande, oriente le CA des trimestres a venir.
Demande sur le coeur historique compresseurs et air, plus gros segment du groupe.
Demande sur le segment sciences de la vie, moteur de croissance a plus forte marge.

kpis.name_fr: Ratio prises de commandes sur facturation
kpis.signal: Superieur a 1 signale un carnet qui se remplit plus vite qu'il ne se vide.
Depasse 450 M$ en 2025, contre environ 200 M$ il y a deux ans, avec une cible de 1 milliard en rythme annuel fin 2027.
Environ 1,1 milliard de revenus futurs deja sous contrat, gage de visibilite et de fidelite client.
525 M$ deployes sur 16 transactions en 2025, generant environ 275 M$ de revenus inorganiques annualises.
Multiple moyen de 9,2x l'EBITDA pre-synergies sur les deals 2025, permettant un ROIC mid-teens des la troisieme annee.
Plus de 200 cibles dans l'entonnoir dont 10 sous lettre d'intention, avec plus de 90 pourcent de deals internes.
Vent contraire tarifaire brut superieur a 100 M$ sur l'annee, principalement Section 232, compense par des hausses de prix decalees vers 2026.
Environ 40 M$ de commandes long-cycle retardees par le conflit au Moyen-Orient, dont un tiers deja recupere en avril, sans impact attendu sur l'annee.
Plus grosse acquisition 2025, entree renforcee dans le gaz naturel renouvelable (RNG).
Ejecteurs et solutions durables, plus jusqu'a 56,5 M$ de complement de prix conditionnel.
Retour de capital record sur l'exercice via le programme de rachat.
Le conseil releve l'enveloppe de rachat de 1 Md$ en mai 2025.
Charges en forte hausse (31,2 M$ en 2024, 19,9 M$ en 2023).

ai_positioning.summary: Ingersoll Rand utilise l'IA/ML dans ses solutions industrielles connectées (Helix) et son excellence opérationnelle (IRX).

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Capital Spending
risks.score_rationale: The company's financial results closely follow changes in general economic conditions and capital spending levels in the industries it serves. Demand for most products depends on new capital investment and maintenance expenditures by customers. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We define Constant Currency as changes in Segment Revenues and Segment Adjusted EBITDA excluding the". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Economic fluctuations can have a significant impact on the company's financial results through changes in customer capital expenditure patterns.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenues (54% for year ended December 31, 2025) is denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar, and much of manufacturing and labor costs are also outside the U.S., creating exposure to exchange rate movements. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We define Constant Currency as changes in Segment Revenues and Segment Adjusted EBITDA excluding the". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations can impact operating results due to significant international revenue and cost exposure.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets where it faces competition on product quality, reliability, pricing, and service responsiveness. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Results of Operations Consolidated results should be read in conjunction with segment results and the". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Intense competition can significantly impact market share and pricing power in the company's operating segments.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology for its operations, making systems vulnerable to security breaches and operational disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Our Corporate operations (as described below) are not discussed separately as any results that had". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Dependence on technology systems creates vulnerability to security failures and operational interruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which can impact operations and financial results. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We define Constant Currency as changes in Segment Revenues and Segment Adjusted EBITDA excluding the". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory changes can impact operations and financial results across the company's global footprint.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials and components such as steel, aluminum, copper, and castings, making operations vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Results of Operations Consolidated results should be read in conjunction with segment results and the". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions could impact the company's ability to manufacture and deliver products to customers.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation for product quality, reliability, and service is essential to maintaining long-standing customer relationships and market positions. Incidents could significantly impact financial results. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Results of Operations Consolidated results should be read in conjunction with segment results and the". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputation damage could significantly impact customer relationships and financial performance given brand reliance.

company_description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. provides mission-critical air, fluid, clean energy, and medical technologies services and solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Industrial Technologies and Services, and Precision and Science Technologies. The Industrial Technologies and Services segment designs, manufactures, markets, and services a range of air and gas compression and treatment equipment, vacuum and blower products, fluid transfer equipment, loading systems, and power tools and lifting equipment; and other specialized equipment, including aftermarket parts, consumables and services, air treatment equipment, controls, other accessories, and services under the Ingersoll Rand, Gardner Denver, Nash, CompAir, Elmo Rietschle, and other brands.
